blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The jolliest bee is heading Down Under. On November 15, Jollibee Group signed franchise development agreements with two Australian companies, setting the stage for the Filipino fast-food giant’s entry into Australia with plans to open 35 stores over the next five years. READ: Jollibee eyes 1,500 areas for expansion For Filipinos living in Australia, the move could bring a familiar taste of home closer. For other Australian diners, it offers an opportunity to discover some of the Philippines’ most recognizable fast-food favorites. Here’s what consumers can expect from Jollibee’s Australian debut.
